# Floating Goat

> Floating Goat is a Copenhagen venue and accommodation located beside Langebro.

## Services

- [Simple Meetings](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/simple-meetings): A flexible space for meetings and small business gatherings.
- [Private Events](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/events/private-selskaber): A venue for private parties, celebrations and gatherings.

## Terms and Conditions

- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/betingelser): Terms and conditions for using Floating Goat's accommodation and event spaces.
